beats.summary: Michael announces a friendly basketball game between office and warehouse staff to boost morale.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Today at lunchtime we're going to be playing the warehouse staff at a friendly little game of basketball.

beats.summary: Dwight wants to be on the basketball team but Michael denies him due to past behavior and assigns him weekend work instead.
